title: Mornington Racecourse Market
summary: Monthly makers market at Mornington Racecourse, with handmade and Australian-designed goods, food stalls and live music. Dogs are not permitted.
recurrenceNote: Monthly – 2nd Sunday of month (year-round; occasionally 3rd Sunday due to racing events)
accessibilityNotes: Lower members car park and racecourse; gravel/bitumen/grass; undulating; use caution with prams
provenance: Mornington Peninsula Shire's current event page and ATDW listing were checked on 2026-10-03. Both list Sunday 11 October 2026, 09:00 to 14:00. The council identifies free entry, paid parking, no dogs, Craft Markets Australia as operator, and the venue map pin. The operator's own next-market block currently says TBC, so later dates need rechecking before travel. The previous record labelled entry Paid and mapped the venue several kilometres away.
nearbyAttractions: Mornington foreshore; Main Street Mornington; MPRG
suggestedItineraryPairing: Pair with Mornington foreshore walk and Main Street dining
editorVerdict: A broad makers market with food and music at the racecourse; check the date before travelling because race days can shift it.
editorNote:
The operator warns that racing can shift the usual second-Sunday schedule, so check the current date before setting off.

The move: browse the makers first, then have lunch on the lawn or continue into Mornington.
